newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber limit down on key months in late trade.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber limit down on key months in late trade.

text.p: CME lumber futures were down the $10 per thousand board foot limit in key months in late trade following a weak expiry to the July contract.
July fell $24.50 per tbf to go off the board shortly after noon at $350.00. Dealers said plentiful supplies in the cash market had led to little interest in taking delivery.
September and November futures went limit down following the expiry. Cash lumber was quiet but the tone was weak.
"A lot of people feel there is enough wood in the pipeline," one dealer said.
